nodes.label: sqlite3_open_v2
nodes.desc: Entry point for connections (L3768): allocates the sqlite3 handle, attaches a B-tree per attached database file, registers the VFS.

nodes.label: sqlite3_exec
nodes.desc: Convenience loop (L30): sqlite3_prepare_v2 + repeated sqlite3_step + finalize for each statement in the string.

nodes.label: sqlite3_prepare_v2
nodes.desc: Public compile API (L972); thin wrapper over the internal sqlite3Prepare driver.

nodes.label: sqlite3_step
nodes.desc: Runs the VDBE until one row is produced or the program halts (L990).

nodes.label: sqlite3Prepare
nodes.desc: Internal compile driver (L717): schema lookups, retry-on-schema-change loop, invokes the tokenizer.

nodes.label: sqlite3RunParser
nodes.desc: Tokenizer loop (L600): sqlite3GetToken classifies bytes; tokens are handed to the Lemon-generated parser.

nodes.label: sqlite3Parser
nodes.desc: LALR(1) grammar (%name sqlite3Parser, L59); tool/lemon.c turns it into parse.c/parse.h; grammar actions build Expr/Select/Trigger objects and call the code generators.

nodes.label: sqlite3StartTable
nodes.desc: Begins CREATE TABLE (L1292): resolves the schema, builds the Table object, allocates root pages.

nodes.label: sqlite3EndTable
nodes.desc: Finishes CREATE TABLE (L2757): writes the sqlite_schema row and emits OP_ParseSchema.

nodes.label: sqlite3Select
nodes.desc: Top-level SELECT compiler (L7807): FROM/WHERE/GROUP BY/ORDER BY all lower to VDBE programs here.

nodes.label: sqlite3ExprCodeTarget
nodes.desc: Expression compiler (L5110): converts an Expr tree into VDBE opcodes that evaluate into registers.

nodes.label: sqlite3WhereBegin
nodes.desc: Query planner entry (L6954): estimates costs, chooses indexes and join order, emits the nested loop opcodes.

nodes.label: sqlite3WhereEnd
nodes.desc: Closes the loops opened by sqlite3WhereBegin and frees the WhereInfo plan (L7657).

nodes.label: sqlite3VdbeExec
nodes.desc: The interpreter core (L903): one giant switch over opcodes (OP_Transaction, OP_Column, OP_SeekRowid, OP_...); opcodes.h is generated by scanning this file.

nodes.label: sqlite3VdbeAddOp3
nodes.desc: Appends an opcode to the program (L274); every code generator funnels through this family. sqlite3VdbeMakeReady (L2664) finalizes the frame.

nodes.label: sqlite3BtreeBeginTrans
nodes.desc: Starts a read or write transaction on a B-tree (L3838); negotiates journal mode and grabs locks through the pager.

nodes.label: sqlite3BtreeCursor
nodes.desc: Positions a cursor on a table/index B-tree (L4802); OP_Column and OP_Seek* drive it from the VM.

nodes.label: accessPayload
nodes.desc: Reads record bytes out of cells, handling local/overflow page spill (L5158).

nodes.label: sqlite3BtreeInsert
nodes.desc: Inserts a record and rebalances the tree (L9445); dirty pages are handed to the pager.

nodes.label: sqlite3BtreeCommit
nodes.desc: Commits the B-tree transaction (L4467); delegates the durability dance to the pager commit phases.

nodes.label: sqlite3PagerSharedLock
nodes.desc: Acquires shared locks and runs hot-journal / wal-index recovery checks (L5323).

nodes.label: sqlite3PagerGet
nodes.desc: Page cache entry point (L5795); getPageNormal (L5604) reads the page or resolves it from the WAL/journal.

nodes.label: pager_write_pagelist
nodes.desc: Rollback-journal path (L4490): after journalling, writes the dirty page list back to the database file.

nodes.label: sqlite3PagerCommitPhaseOne
nodes.desc: Commit phase 1 (L6534): sync the journal, or in WAL mode hand frames to sqlite3WalFrames (pager.c:3280).

nodes.label: sqlite3PagerCommitPhaseTwo
nodes.desc: Commit phase 2 (L6771): makes everything durable and returns the pager to a clean state.

nodes.label: walIndexRecover
nodes.desc: Rebuilds the wal-index from the -wal file after a crash (L1422).

nodes.label: sqlite3WalFindFrame
nodes.desc: Binary-searches the wal-index for the newest frame of a page (L3737); called from pager.c read paths.

nodes.label: sqlite3WalReadFrame
nodes.desc: Copies a page image out of a log frame (L3755).

nodes.label: sqlite3WalBeginWriteTransaction
nodes.desc: Takes the WAL write lock so frames can be appended (L3800); single writer at a time.

nodes.label: sqlite3WalFrames
nodes.desc: Public wrapper (L4376) over walFrames: appends dirty pages as frames to the -wal file and syncs.

nodes.label: sqlite3OsWrite
nodes.desc: VFS dispatch trampoline (L92): forwards to whatever sqlite3_vfs is registered (sqlite3OsRead L88).

nodes.label: unixRead
nodes.desc: Unix VFS read method (L3512): pread-style reads on the database or -wal file.

nodes.label: unixWrite
nodes.desc: Unix VFS write method (L3643): pwrite-style writes; sync variants fsync.

nodes.label: sqlite3_malloc64
nodes.desc: Allocator front door (L322): routes to the pluggable allocator; sqlite3MallocInit (L159) wires it up.
